predecessors.name: Belgian Congo
predecessors.text: Ruanda, the northern half of the Belgian-administered Ruanda-Urundi: 'Part of Ruanda-Urundi: 1916–1962'

ledger.x: 1 July 1962: Rwanda becomes independent of Belgium, already a republic.
August 1998: the Second Congo War opens and Rwanda holds the Kivus.
7 August 1999: the Rwandan and Ugandan armies fight in Kisangani.
17 August 1999: a ceasefire halts the first Kisangani fighting.
May 2000: Rwanda and Uganda fight again in Kisangani.
June 2000: the second Kisangani fighting ends.
5 October 2002: Rwanda announces the end of its withdrawal from the DR Congo.

wars.name: Rwandan Civil War
wars.outcome: The RPF 'invaded northern Rwanda from their base in Uganda' in 1990; after the genocide began on 6 April 1994 'the RPF ended the genocide with a military victory in July 1994'.

wars.name: Second Congo War
wars.outcome: Rwanda signed the Pretoria Accord with the DR Congo on 30 July 2002 and completed its withdrawal on 5 October 2002; the war 'officially ended on 18 July 2003 with the establishment of the Transitional Government'.

certainty.note: Inherited Ruanda-Urundi boundaries 'broken up along traditional lines' in 1962; the page records no change or dispute since.
